lenders.name: TDECU (Texas Dow Employees Credit Union)
lenders.offer: Indirect retail financing completed at the dealership for autos, boats, RVs, motorcycles, and ATVs/UTVs; advertised auto terms up to 84 months and boat/RV terms up to 179 months; available through hundreds of Texas dealerships.

lenders.name: Randolph-Brooks Federal Credit Union (RBFCU)
lenders.offer: Preferred Dealers / Dealer Direct: members can apply and close auto, motorcycle, RV, and boat loans at participating dealers, with a decision in minutes and no extra application fee versus applying at the credit union.

lenders.name: A+ Federal Credit Union
lenders.offer: Published partner-dealership program with car, truck, RV, motorcycle, and power sports dealers across Texas; members can finance through listed partner lots (auto and RV partners are named by region on the official list).

lenders.name: Huntington Bank (RV & Marine Finance)
lenders.offer: Dealer-arranged/indirect specialty financing for RVs, boats, and powersports; consumer site lists Texas residents as eligible, with RV/boat terms up to 180 months and powersports up to 72 months. A Huntington RV & Marine dealer-support directory (dated April 18, 2022) lists dealer support contacts and a Texas relationship manager — re-verify current dealer coverage.

lenders.name: U.S. Bank
lenders.offer: Auto: franchise dealer retail and lease finance via Dealertrack/RouteOne, including eContracting and dealer reserve. RV/boat: dealers that use U.S. Bank as a lender can participate in the U.S. Bank RV and Boat Marketplace (nationwide; article dated July 11, 2023 — confirm current enrollment).

lenders.name: Aqua Finance
lenders.offer: Dealer installment contracts for boats, motors/re-powers, personal watercraft, motorhomes, and towable RVs; applications through AppOne or Dealertrack, with no prepayment penalties advertised. Company history states it expanded consumer financing to dealers in all 50 states (including Texas); confirm current Texas dealer enrollment.

lenders.name: Trident Funding
lenders.offer: Dealer/broker referral program (Finance Advantage): matches boat and RV deals to a network of 40+ lenders; Trident handles underwriting, processing, and title/registration. Official location page lists Texas among served states. This is a dealer-facing marketplace/referral model, not necessarily Trident holding the paper itself.

lenders.name: Sheffield Financial (a division of Truist Bank)
lenders.offer: Dealer retail installment financing for powersports, marine, golf cars, trailers, and outdoor power equipment; dealer enrollment, dealer portal applications, online prequalification, and advertised 15-minute credit decisions / 24-hour funding. National program; Texas powersports dealers have published Sheffield as a finance option.

lenders.name: Roadrunner Financial
lenders.offer: Dealer powersports and outdoor power equipment retail financing: online applications with instant decisions, digital contracts, and programs for first-time, non-prime, and prime buyers on new and used units; dealers must be approved and sign a dealer agreement.

lenders.name: FreedomRoad Financial (loan production office of Old Second National Bank)
lenders.offer: National powersports retail loans originated through dealers (including authorized Triumph, Husqvarna, and KTM dealers, plus other OEM dealer programs); advertised quick decisions, flexible terms on new and used products, and 7-day dealer support. Texas dealer promotions have offered FreedomRoad financing.

lenders.name: Yamaha Motor Finance Corporation, U.S.A. (Yamaha Financial Services)
lenders.offer: Captive financing solutions for Yamaha dealers and Yamaha customers nationwide, supporting retail purchases of Yamaha products (powersports and marine).

lenders.name: Honda Financial Services
lenders.offer: Captive retail financing for Honda Powersports products; official guidance is to apply at an authorized Honda dealer or through Honda Financial Services (subject to credit approval).

lenders.name: Security Service Federal Credit Union
lenders.offer: San Antonio-based credit union whose current auto-loan page directs members to shorten financing by shopping within its trusted dealer network (operates in Texas, Colorado, and Utah). Current page confirms a dealer network; it does not publish a full dealer list or other-vehicle dealer terms on that page.

lenders.name: Shell Federal Credit Union
lenders.offer: Preferred-dealer program through Shell FCU Member Auto Center: official list of 86 participating Houston-area auto dealers; members can get pre-approved and complete financing with the listed dealer representatives.

lenders.name: Ally Auto (Ally Financial)
lenders.offer: National dealer platform for personal auto financing, specialty vehicle financing, wholesale inventory/floorplan financing, and dealer loans, plus F&I and dealer-rewards programs.

lenders.name: Santander Consumer USA
lenders.offer: Indirect auto purchase and lease financing through a dealer portal (Dealertrack eContracting); advertises about 14,000 active franchise dealer relationships and 135 dealer relationship managers across the U.S., with same-day funding on complete contract packages.

lenders.name: Toyota Financial Services (Toyota Motor Credit Corporation)
lenders.offer: Captive retail installment and lease financing, plus other financial services, for authorized Toyota and Lexus dealers and their customers in most of the United States (including Texas Toyota/Lexus stores).

lenders.name: GM Financial
lenders.offer: Captive dealer financing platform for GM dealers (GMF Connect / Approval Center): submit and rehash retail deals, check contract status, and access dealer programs and inventory tools.
